title: Organisation module packages on the Structure contract
summary: APES CIC, Pet Care Clinic, and Shelter and Rescue now load as module packages with package-owned manifests, hubs, live prefixes, and composed plugins. Settings defaults and per-module plugin dependencies move out of Core hard-coding while live URLs and permission strings stay the same.
changes: Add module.php manifests for apes-cic, pet-care-clinic, and shelter-rescue covering nav, hub route, live prefix, enabled flag, and composed plugins.
Move APES CIC tickets, cases, and recruitment settings defaults into the apes-cic package config so Core no longer special-cases that module.
Declare Cases → Pet Profiles for Shelter and Consultations → Pet Profiles for Pet Care on plugin manifests instead of a hard-coded matrix match.
Keep the shared Core hub view fed by each module manifest; plugin controllers and models stay under App until later Structure waves.
version_rationale: Patch on v0.37.x: Structure Wave 4 module packages with no live URL or permission-string renames.
validation: php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
composer pre-pr-verify / CI before merge; Cloudron workflow_dispatch with app_version from VERSION after merge.
known_limitations: Plugin controllers and models remain under App\Http and App\Models until Waves 5–7 move them into plugins/<slug>.
Module hub views still use the shared Core sub-cores.show template; packages may override via hubView later.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. No database migration runs in this release; rolling back application code restores Core-owned settings defaults and the hard-coded matrix dependency match.
provenance: Structure Wave 4 module packages #284 (APES CIC), #285 (Pet Care Clinic), and #286 (Shelter and Rescue) via pull request #307.
